build_SO2_m_Conv: build an SO(2) convolution module for a single spherical harmonic order m with real and imaginary output channels
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build an optimized block-diagonal GEMM SO(2) convolution module for order m that is 1.3 to 1.5x faster
build_SO2_Convolution: build a full SO(2) convolution block processing all m orders with optional radial MLP weights and extra m0 gating
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO(2) linear layer for all m orders with optional radial function modulation and coefficient mapping
convert_SO2_Convolution_to_block: convert an existing SO2_Convolution instance to the faster SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock or SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock with identical weights
